summary: Tested the new Teacher Attendance / Lecture Execution report (تقرير حضور الأساتذة وتنفيذ المحاضرات) end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_teacher_attendance_report.py with 15 pytest cases (shape, summary math consistency, grouped-vs-flat totals, date defaults, faculty/department filters, invalid/reversed date ranges, auth 403, excel+pdf export payload signatures) — 15/15 pass. Frontend: admin login -> Reports card -> /report-teacher-attendance; date range 2026-04-01..2026-08-30 returns summary 19 محاضرة / 1 نُفّذت / 18 غياب / 0 ملغاة / 5.3%; both tabs (حسب الأستاذ with expandable teacher cards + status pills, حسب المحاضرات flat list) render correctly in Arabic RTL; faculty filter 19->10 (كلية الشريعة) and 9 (كلية البنات), department filter sends department_id and dept picker correctly resets when faculty changes (verified via intercepted network requests); Excel (.xlsx) and PDF downloads both trigger with correct filenames. Mobile 390px layout renders acceptably. Two defects found: (1) the new data-testid attributes were not reaching the DOM on TouchableOpacity (RN Web needs testID) — fixed by me; (2) typing a date manually into the date inputs wipes the value (DateField declared inside the component => remount on every keystroke) — needs main-agent fix.

minor.issue: 11 of 19 lectures in the test range are grouped under 'غير معيّن' because their courses have no teacher_id — per-teacher accountability is therefore incomplete. Consider falling back to lecture.teacher_id / schedule teacher, or surfacing a warning row for unassigned lectures.
Non-date strings (start_date=not-a-date) are accepted and silently return an empty report (no 400 validation).

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH: `DateField` is declared inside the screen component, so every state change recreates the component type and React remounts the <input type=date>. Typing a date manually (keyboard) ends with BOTH fields empty and the report runs for today (0 results). Repro: focus 'من تاريخ', type 04/01/2026 -> value stays empty. Fix: hoist DateField outside the component (or inline the JSX) and add validation for empty / from>to ranges.

FIXED BY TESTER: new interactive elements used `data-testid=` on RN `TouchableOpacity`, which react-native-web drops (it maps `testID` -> data-testid). None of run-report-btn / tab-* / export-* / report-teacher-attendance-btn existed in the DOM. Converted them to `testID` and added data-testid to the two date inputs (ta-date-from / ta-date-to). NOTE: the other pre-existing report cards in reports.tsx (report-student-btn, report-course-btn, report-daily-btn, report-teacher-delays-btn, report-lesson-completion-btn, etc.) still use data-testid and remain untestable — main agent should migrate them to testID.
STATUS_META[l.status] is dereferenced without a fallback; any status the backend adds later (or an empty status) throws a render crash. Add a default entry.

issues: Native <input type=date> renders in browser locale (mm/dd/yyyy) inside an Arabic RTL screen — inconsistent with the rest of the app which uses styled pickers elsewhere
The 'من تاريخ' / 'إلى تاريخ' labels are right-aligned inside each field box, so in RTL the 'من تاريخ' label visually sits next to the neighbouring field and can be misread
Empty/invalid range gives no inline validation message, just an empty list

action_items: Hoist DateField out of TeacherAttendanceReport (or inline the inputs) so manual date typing does not reset the value; add validation for empty date / from>to.
Add a fallback entry for unknown lecture status in STATUS_META to avoid render crashes.
Migrate remaining data-testid usages on TouchableOpacity in reports.tsx (and other screens) to testID so they reach the DOM.
Decide product behaviour for lectures whose course has no teacher_id (11/19 in the test data land in 'غير معيّن').
critical_code_review_comments: report-teacher-attendance.tsx: inner component definition (DateField) causes remounts on every keystroke — classic React anti-pattern, root cause of the date input bug.

server.py _build_teacher_attendance_report: teacher lookup is done per-teacher with await inside the lecture loop (cached, so OK), but department/faculty filtering happens after loading ALL lectures in the range (limit 10000) — consider filtering at the query level for larger ranges.
server.py: start_date/end_date are plain strings with no format validation; a malformed value silently yields an empty report instead of 400.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (navigation, run, tabs, filters, both exports pass; manual date typing fails)

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: this app is react-native-web — data-testid on TouchableOpacity does NOT render; use testID in source and query [data-testid=...] in Playwright. Login: fill the two inputs then click the 'تسجيل الدخول' text (Enter key does not submit). Report screen testids: ta-date-from, ta-date-to, today-chip, run-report-btn, tab-by-teacher, tab-by-lecture, teacher-att-<id>, export-teacher-att-excel, export-teacher-att-pdf, report-teacher-attendance-btn. Use page.fill() for dates (typing is broken). Backend regression suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_teacher_attendance_report.py.
rca_of_the_issue: Date-typing bug: DateField is a function component declared in the body of TeacherAttendanceReport, so each render produces a new component type; React unmounts/remounts the underlying <input type=date>, discarding in-progress input and leaving state '' — the report then runs with empty dates and the backend defaults to today (0 rows). Testid bug: react-native-web only forwards the `testID` prop to a data-testid attribute; raw `data-testid` props on TouchableOpacity are stripped, so the new controls were invisible to automation.
